Funky spot with great vibes & beer.
Dec 2025 • Couples
Didn’t expect to find a craft brewery in HCMC! A funky little place in District 1 that turned out to be a great find. We had the Black Rice Lager & the Pandan Lager. Both tasted exactly as stated. The Pandan Lager, with just enough pandan in the bouquet & in the mouth was the hit - but those who like a nice dark caramel beer would have been just as impressed with the Black Rice Lager. Upstairs you can watch the the night life of District 1 go by & downstairs that had some nice live music. 

Verdict: great vibe & nice beers - will go back to try some more.

A great "new" bar in HCMC serving a fantastic collection of mainly their own beers at super competitive prices. A 400ml glass of their own core range beer is just 90,000 Dong which is far cheaper than other similar bars in the city. The beer quality has improved greatly too in recent times. Food here is also good quality and keenly priced. Great service and wifi too. Probably the top craft beer bar in the city these days.
